paragraphs: Rabbi Natan bar Tovi, (a student of Rabbi Yohanan).

Berakhot 28a relates that when Rabbi Zeira tired from studying, he sat at Rabbi Natan bar Tovi’s doorway. Natan came out. Zeira asked: “Who stated a ruling in the study hall?” He answered: “Rabbi Yohanan says that the law does not follow Rabbi Yehudah.” Zeira learned it from him forty times. Natan asked Zeira: “Is this your only teaching, or is it new to you?” etc.
Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1, 26b, likewise has him disputing Rabbi Zeira in Rabbi Yohanan’s name about the afternoon prayer.

notes.text: The checked Berakhot passage explicitly names Rabbi Yehudah. Zeira learns the teaching from Natan forty times, and Natan addresses the ensuing question to Zeira. The Yerushalmi citation retains Hyman’s 26b folio suffix.

The inspected Davidson Berakhot 28a Hebrew and its English translation support Ze’ira asking Natan, learning the ruling from him forty times, and Natan asking Ze’ira whether it is new to him. The Yehudah expansion is explicit in the full passage; the supplied Yerushalmi folio locator is retained.
